title: LiveAgentStreamControl
description: live.agent-stream-control@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S5): one of the four controls the owner and the channel's moderators have over a live agent stream, with who pressed it. PAUSE tells the task's service (Codes or Actor) to pause at the next safe point; the overlay then says 'Paused by @mod'. CURTAIN is the S1 curtain, raised from the viewer side. MUTE is the S4 mute: the agent voice stops. END ends the stream and the room's Co-pilot reading, while the task itself keeps running off camera unless it was paused. A moderator may press all four, but may not resume a pause the owner set and may not change the mode or the task. Every press is logged: who, which control, when.

by.description: Who pressed it: the handle and the role they hold. Never an id, never anything else about them.

handle.description: The handle of the person who pressed the control.

role.description: What they are on this stream: the owner, or one of the channel's moderators.

stream.description: The agent stream the control was pressed on.

paused_by.description: The handle of the person whose pause is in force, or null when the stream is not paused. A moderator cannot resume the owner's pause: this says whose it is.
